$comment: CLOSED, committed exemption list for scripts/lang-gate.mjs (ADR-M004 D7). GENERATED from the frozen sources (schemas/*.json descriptions, schemas/forbidden-keys.json, packages/contracts/src/enums.ts) so the strings are byte-exact; the output is committed and static. terms=whole-token exempt (frozen contract identifiers, FORBIDDEN_KEYS, COVERAGE_REASONS, Shogen fixture keys, proper nouns). phrases=exact-substring exempt (the internal corpus proper name, CI job names). The 5 frozen JSON-Schema descriptions were re-issued in English by ADR-M001 D9-bis (2026-09-10, annotation-only erratum), so their French phrases are REMOVED from this list and the formed pending is closed. patterns=regex refs (ADR-M00x, R-xx, §, harness_version). paths=whole-FILE exemptions by repo-relative glob (K-2 / ADR-M005 D3): the Shogen fixtures fixtures/s3-binance.* are verbatim third-party artifacts, sha256-pinned and non-translatable (the verifier output is French: 'VERDICT : valide sous A(notary-neutrality), ...'); a path-exempt file is not scanned at all, and removing its entry here un-skips it so the French reddens the root scope (path mechanism, NOT phrase masking — the fixtures stay byte-frozen). Removing a frozen identifier here reddens the gate on that token (test 42 mutant) — the exemption is load-bearing. ADR-M004 D7 quater (2026-09-07): frozen TEST-NAME identifiers defined in ADR-M002 that collide with an fr-word are also exempt terms — 'fictitious_default_le_n_rounds' (test #19) and 'interval_lo_le_hi' (hikae test #15), where the substring '_le_' is the abbreviation for the math relation ≤, not the French article; the generator only covered schema/enum sources, never ADR-defined test names.
phrases: Compliance et ingénierie logicielle et architecturale
